dialogues.speaker: Martha
dialogues.text: That suspicious guy from Sumeru... *sigh* I should keep Moce a bit farther away from him...

dialogues.speaker: Martha
dialogues.text: Hmm? Ah, welcome, guests from afar. I'm Martha Pasquale, the matron of Pasquale's Instruments.

dialogues.speaker: Martha
dialogues.text: If you have any musical instruments you'd like to order, you can go straight to my husband, Giovanni.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A suspicious person from Sumeru, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Martha
dialogues.text: Ah yes, that guy over there. The name's... Chan... something? Ugh. I don't remember exactly, but it was hard to pronounce.

dialogues.speaker: Martha
dialogues.text: He came into town some time back, claiming to be a researcher from Sumeru. Well, I've never seen him do any research. He just plays cards all day with the Doge's granddaughter...

dialogues.speaker: Martha
dialogues.text: Can't figure out half the things he talks about normally either. "Moving statues" this, "voices in the walls" that... *sigh* Maybe we should get Ms. Contarini to investigate him...

dialogues.speaker: Martha
dialogues.text: *sigh* My mischievous son. Sorry if he's given you any trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Martha
dialogues.text: That boy's been a restless soul since Giovanni told him about how his uncle sailed off to Sumeru. That's what you get when you fill a child's head with dreams of adventure...

dialogues.speaker: Martha
dialogues.text: But what if one of those suspicious Sumeru folk reel him in, and then, and then... Ah! No, no, how horrifying! I can't bear the thought!
